Master of Education
in Special Education

Salve Regina University’s online Master of Education (M.Ed.) in Special Education equips you with the knowledge, strategies, and skills to support learners with diverse needs across early childhood, elementary, and secondary settings. Rooted in Salve’s longstanding tradition of teacher education, this fully online program is built for working educators ready to deepen their impact and meet the growing demand for qualified special educators.

SALVE REGINA UNIVERSITY | M.Ed. in Special Education

Program Overview

Salve’s M.Ed. in Special Education prepares educators to support students with disabilities and diverse learning needs across early childhood, elementary, and secondary settings — built for working educators and aspiring specialists ready to advance their credentials. Applicants provide official undergraduate transcripts (3.0 GPA recommended), a résumé, two letters of recommendation, and a personal statement.

About Salve Regina

Founded by the Sisters of Mercy in 1947, Salve Regina University is a Catholic institution known for excellence in learning and fueling the imagination of students to bring forward progressive ideas that marry intellect and spiritual growth.

We enroll nearly 2,700 undergraduate and graduate students from across the globe. Our programs are designed to support a world that is harmonious, just and merciful by integrating student experience and personal values with competency in theory and in practice.

  • Financial aid is available
  • Join our program to discover the difference Salve can make in your personal and professional life
  • Opportunities for professional development within a holistic model of education backed by the Mercy Mission
  • Preparation to meet the growing demand for qualified special educators

M.Ed. Curriculum

Salve Regina University’s online M.Ed. in Special Education combines foundational knowledge in disability studies, special education law, and instructional design with deep dives into concentration-specific content. Every course is taught by faculty with real classroom and clinical experience, bringing theory to life through practical application.

Students choose one of three concentrations — early childhood, elementary, or secondary special education — each designed to align with Rhode Island Department of Education certification requirements. Ready to deepen your impact? Apply to Salve Regina University’s fully online M.Ed. today.

Required Courses

SED-508Multicultural Perspectives in Special Education
SED-510Ethics and Legal Foundations of Special Education
SED-530Research Methods in Special Education
SED-535Inclusive Instruction in Special Education
SED-538Intensive Instruction in Special Education
SED-540Assessment and Data-Driven Decision Making
SED-545Understanding and Managing Behavior in Special Education
SED-550Partnering with Families in Special Education
SED-598Graduate Special Education Internship

Students also complete concentration-specific coursework in their chosen track.
